final_answer:
Three high-risk user requirements are not currently verified.

I counted a requirement as high-risk if its functional risk assessment (FRA) item is HIGH. The PFMEA items that mitigate these requirements agree with that. I counted it as verified if a linked test case, directly or through its functional, configuration or design spec, has executions that all passed and are not superseded by a failure.

| Requirement | Reason not verified |
|---|---|
| **URS-INC-004** (door-open alarm within 60 s) | TC-OQ-INC-04 failed on incubator INC-03. The alarm activated at 142 s against a 60 s limit (TX-0023, DEV-26-011). The OQ report was approved with this exception. The re-test on INC-03 is required by CC-26-019, but that change control is "APPROVED – NOT IMPLEMENTED" and no passing re-execution exists. |
| **URS-EBR-009** (target MOI outside 4.0–6.0 TU/cell rejected for GMP runs) | No test case verifies it. It traces to CS-EBR-03, the MOI range-check hard stop. No test case is linked to CS-EBR-03 or to the URS itself. The only EBR vector tests are TC-OQ-EBR-04, which covers the vector volume calculation (CS-EBR-02 and URS-EBR-007), and nothing exercises the rejection. |
| **URS-CRF-001** (freezing profile CRF-P01 within ±2 °C with a representative load) | The only test is TC-OQ-CRF-01, run on an empty chamber. There is no loaded or PQ test for the controlled-rate freezer. The "representative load" part of the requirement is untested. |

Two other high-risk requirements are worth a look, but I did not count them as unverified.
- **URS-EMS-014** (alarm escalation by SMS and voice within 15 min): the escalation test (TC-OQ-EMS-04) passed on 2026-01-20. CC-26-011 then rebuilt the notification groups on a new paging provider on 2026-03-16. That change control states no re-testing is required, so I treated the requirement as verified. If you doubt that assessment, it is the one to re-check.
- **URS-PRDG-002** (locked parameters and ≥90% CD3+ purity): the linked test, TC-OQ-PRDG-02, only checks program lock and version. The purity part is not covered by any test case.

Three high-risk user requirements are not currently verified.

I counted a requirement as high-risk if its functional risk assessment (FRA) item is HIGH. The PFMEA items that mitigate these requirements agree with that. I counted it as verified if a linked test case, directly or through its functional, configuration or design spec, has executions that all passed and are not superseded by a failure.

| Requirement | Reason not verified |
|---|---|
| **URS-INC-004** (door-open alarm within 60 s) | TC-OQ-INC-04 failed on incubator INC-03. The alarm activated at 142 s against a 60 s limit (TX-0023, DEV-26-011). The OQ report was approved with this exception. The re-test on INC-03 is required by CC-26-019, but that change control is "APPROVED – NOT IMPLEMENTED" and no passing re-execution exists. |
| **URS-EBR-009** (target MOI outside 4.0–6.0 TU/cell rejected for GMP runs) | No test case verifies it. It traces to CS-EBR-03, the MOI range-check hard stop. No test case is linked to CS-EBR-03 or to the URS itself. The only EBR vector tests are TC-OQ-EBR-04, which covers the vector volume calculation (CS-EBR-02 and URS-EBR-007), and nothing exercises the rejection. |
| **URS-CRF-001** (freezing profile CRF-P01 within ±2 °C with a representative load) | The only test is TC-OQ-CRF-01, run on an empty chamber. There is no loaded or PQ test for the controlled-rate freezer. The "representative load" part of the requirement is untested. |

Two other high-risk requirements are worth a look, but I did not count them as unverified.
- **URS-EMS-014** (alarm escalation by SMS and voice within 15 min): the escalation test (TC-OQ-EMS-04) passed on 2026-01-20. CC-26-011 then rebuilt the notification groups on a new paging provider on 2026-03-16. That change control states no re-testing is required, so I treated the requirement as verified. If you doubt that assessment, it is the one to re-check.
- **URS-PRDG-002** (locked parameters and ≥90% CD3+ purity): the linked test, TC-OQ-PRDG-02, only checks program lock and version. The purity part is not covered by any test case.
